# Utsa Das Portfolio

> Utsa Das is a Founder and SEO + GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Strategist focused on building digital systems that dominate both traditional search and AI discovery for beauty and personal care brands.

This website serves as a professional portfolio and service showcase for Utsa Das, highlighting expertise in SEO, GEO, and Ecommerce strategy.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://utsadas.com/): Overview of Utsa Das's work, target audience, and the importance of SEO + GEO.
- [Services](https://utsadas.com/services.html): Detailed breakdown of SEO Strategy, GEO Optimization, and Ecommerce Strategy.
- [About](https://utsadas.com/about.html): Background on Utsa Das and the mission behind his work.
- [Skills](https://utsadas.com/skills.html): Technical and strategic skills including SEO tools and methodologies.
- [Testimonials](https://utsadas.com/testimonials.html): Client feedback and success stories.
- [FAQ](https://utsadas.com/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about SEO, GEO, and working with Utsa.
- [Contact](https://utsadas.com/contact.html): Information on how to start a project or connect with Utsa.

## Additional Pages

- [SEO Audit](https://utsadas.com/seo-audit.html): Information regarding technical SEO audits and free audit requests.
